result.summary:
Read lib/letflow/design/iss0273-h6-floor-commit-pin.md in full (not CODE-DESIGNER's result.summary) plus step-01-issue-fixer.json and step-02-code-designer.json in full, and the current lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex:100-230 to confirm the design's line-number claims match the real file.

Independently re-derived (not copied) every sha-ancestry claim, on this branch, via real git commands:
- `git show -s --format="%H %P" 184d846` -> `184d846cd8838ea2bd9a6d3b54cda36ca0e280b0 c4a8e39729e253397d4f1aa34155a74522930252` -- confirms c4a8e397...930252 is 184d846's sole parent, full 40-char form matches the design exactly.
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor 184d846 184d846; echo $?` -> exit 0 -- confirms --is-ancestor reflexivity (a commit is its own ancestor), which is the basis for why pinning to 184d846 itself (not its parent) would be wrong.
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor 184d846 c4a8e397; echo $?` -> exit 1 -- 184d846 is NOT an ancestor of the parent.
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor c4a8e397 184d846; echo $?` -> exit 0 -- the parent IS an ancestor of 184d846, confirming the parent relationship the other direction.
- `git log --follow --diff-filter=A --format=%H --reverse -- test/fixtures/lint_handoffs/h6/step-01-fixture-non-json.md` -> `184d846cd8838ea2bd9a6d3b54cda36ca0e280b0` -- confirms the fixture's first-add commit is 184d846 itself, so (per the reflexivity + ancestor results above) pinning the floor to the parent c4a8e397 correctly leaves the fixture classified hard_new (184d846 is not an ancestor of c4a8e397), while pinning to 184d846 itself would reflexively misclassify it as pre-floor/grandfathered.
All four/five outputs match the design doc's §2.1/§2.2 transcripts exactly -- re-derived, not trusted.

No `.ex` function bodies (no `def`/`defp` blocks with executable statements) appear anywhere in the document -- confirmed by reading the full file.

1. Exact 40-char sha + verified reasoning -- design §2, §2.1, §2.2; matches my independent re-derivation above.
2. Disposition of resolve_h6_floor_commit/0 + BOOTSTRAP sentinel -- design §3: removed entirely (function deleted, not deprecated), with justification (§3.1) and resulting @spec/behavior (§3.2). Unambiguous, no TBD.
3. Cross-checked against the live file: lines 122-133 (BOOTSTRAP paragraph), 184-195 (h6_floor_commit/0), 197-212 (resolve_h6_floor_commit/0) all match the design's cited line numbers exactly.

Test guidance for the 3 failing tests -- design §5: traces all three (F-H6-FIRES-NEW, F-H6-CONTENT-NEVER-READ, T-NEW-AFTER-FLOOR-HARD-FAILS) to the production no-explicit-floor call path, and states existing fixtures suffice with no new fixture or assertion changes needed; also addresses the 4 unaffected T-PRE-FLOOR-* tests and F-GRANDFATHERED-NOT-NEW as a regression-guard check.
